title: FBI records on Karl Compton destroyed, FOIA reply

tellings.quote: Quote unquote, records which may [music] have been responsive to your request were destroyed August 30th, 2006.

plain: The FBI's records on the physicist Karl Compton were destroyed in 2006, according to an April 2014 reply to a request under FOIA, a US law that lets anyone request government records. Michels quotes the reply, which was given to the records researcher John Greenewald Jr.: "records which may have been responsive to your request were destroyed August 30th, 2006." The reply says the records were destroyed but not what was in them or why, and Michels brings it up in an episode about a presidential adviser who says he handled UFO material.
